goal: Create docs/architecture.md explaining this repository's architecture for a new contributor.
acceptance: The guide identifies the real entry points, main components, and their relationships with concrete file references.
The guide explains how to run the relevant tests and distinguishes verified facts from assumptions.
constraints: Only create or update docs/architecture.md; do not change application code, publish anything, or discard unrelated work.
Do not expose credentials or include private data in the guide.
instructions: Inspect the repository, write an evidence-based guide, check referenced paths, and report completion evidence. A nonempty-file check alone does not prove the guide is accurate.
